entry: Post-only modeled next1h open; reject marketable price proxy. Valid60minutes [placedAt,placedAt+1h). Trade-through beyondtick + volume-participation cap; no chase/taker conversion. Preserve partial fills, cancel remainder at60min or when exits start; block inventory that cannot be protected at minimum quantity.
target: Compute target after actual filled and rounded sellable quantity so FULL maker target delivers>=1.60*initial net stop risk AFTER maker buy0.1%, maker sell0.1%, dust and conservative modeled buffer. Round target UP. Reject proposed gross target<2%; do not construct forecast edge from an arbitrary farther target.
makerBuffer: Maker target fills EXACTLY at its resting limit (never below sell limit). Extra uncertainty reserve equal to entry-notional*effectiveFriction is debited separately pro-rata at maker exits, not represented as an OKX fee or worse maker price. Effective friction=(1+slippage)*(1+spread/2)-1. Stop fill uses this friction in taker price, with no duplicate maker reserve.
protection: Evaluate at CLOSED1m net trade liquidation PnL>=1.0*initial net stop risk; raise stop to secure projected total trade PnL>=+0.15Rnet after taker fee/friction, roundingUP, including realized partial-target proceeds. Cancel any unfilled entry remainder before protecting. Never lower/retroactively act; new stop valid following minute only. Gaps may exceed projected floor.
targetPosting: After each entry fill, target is recomputed for actual inventory and posted only after that minute closes if above modeled bid; otherwise it is not counted as maker, and fixed-price posting can be retried at later closes. A new entry-fill minute cannot also receive target profit. No TP market fallback.
intrabar: Minute evidence for ALL entry hours and every later hour where stop, target or1R activation might be reached. Missing event-hour evidence pauses replay; fetch that public hour and rerun deterministically. Stop wins if both touched. Maker sell fills require resting target + strict penetration beyondtick + participation cap; partial residual below minimum blocks rather than inventing sale. No same-hour portfolio reuse.
